about: Composite progress for `score:<n>` goals: sum of weight x (signal now - signal when the judge started). Points anchored on 1 achievement point; a typical achievement is 10. The run's score is the rate: progress points per hour. Quests score by difficulty (quest_points): base x colour of the quest's level against yours at turn-in x quest type (QuestInfoID). Signals with no weight (quests, deaths, money_copper, arena_points, creatures_killed, played_s) are reported but not scored; deaths cost through lost time.
